about: Button. Props land as attributes; CSS resolves look. Progressive enhancement: - With `href` / `as="a"` it is a real link (works without JS). - `busy` is an enhancement on top of a still-valid disabled

map.Label: children
map.State: default: CSS, hover: CSS, active: CSS, disabled: disabled, pressed: pressed

as.about: Polymorphic root. Pass "a" (or provide href) for a progressive link.

tone.about: Consequence, crossed with `variant`. "danger" for destructive or irreversible actions; the colour is the pack's, and the label still has to say what happens. Neutral renders no attribute.

pressed.about: Makes the button a toggle: true or false renders `aria-pressed`, left out it is an ordinary button. A toggle defaults to `outline`, because a solid button has nowhere to go when it is switched on. Not

busy.about: Progressive busy state — disables activation and announces to AT.

busyLabel.about: The words while it is busy: "Posting…", "Saving…". The label changes to them and back, in a polite live region that is there from the first render, so a screen reader hears the change while focus stay

reason.about: Why a disabled button is unavailable. Shown beside it on hover and on focus, and read as its description. A disabled button stays in the tab order so it can say this; without a reason it is still focu

icon.about: Bound icon slot. Prefer this when you have one icon and a position. Maps to leading or trailing via `iconPosition` (default leading). With no children, renders icon-only (set `aria-label`).

iconPosition.about: Where `icon` lands. Ignored when `leading` / `trailing` are passed.

leading.about: Explicit leading slot (wins over `icon` when both are set).

trailing.about: Explicit trailing slot (wins over `icon` when both are set).
